Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the MS section is an interaction proteomics study (AP-MS) to identify the nuclear interactomes of Dot1L and menin. While the broader paper contains many pharmacological and genetic perturbations (siRNA, inhibitors), those are tied to RNA-seq and functional assays, not the MS dataset (PXD026864). The MS comparison is specifically between the bait proteins (Dot1L, menin) and the IgG control.
